statement: For a company to qualify for Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI), the value of its gross assets (for a parent company, the group assets) must not exceed £120 million and its full-time equivalent employee number (for a parent company, that of the company and its qualifying subsidiaries combined) must be less than 500; for a specified Northern Ireland company the limits are £30 million and 250. These limits apply from 6 April 2026.
caveat: Whether a company qualifies is facts-based and these limits are only two of the Schedule 5 Part 3 requirements: the independence, qualifying-subsidiaries, trading-activities, and UK permanent establishment requirements are separate conditions this card does not state, and the employee's working-time requirement is a separate eligibility condition on the individual. Options granted before 6 April 2026 were subject to the previous £30 million and 250 limits; Finance Act 2026 s 13(9)-(10) carries the commencement and transitional provisions. The notification deadline is the separate card uk.emi-notification-deadline.
